lessons.title: A single neuron
lessons.goal: Teach what one neuron computes using only NumPy in Jupyter. Write neuron(x, w, b) that returns the dot product of inputs and weights plus a bias, and try it on three inputs.
lessons.passes: neuron gives 0.5 for inputs 1, 2, 3 with weights 0.5, -1, 0.5 and bias 0.5.

lessons.title: Activation functions
lessons.goal: Teach sigmoid, tanh and ReLU as NumPy functions that work on whole arrays, then add a sigmoid to the neuron so its output stays between 0 and 1.
lessons.passes: sigmoid(0) is 0.5, relu(-2) is 0 and the neuron's output lies between 0 and 1.

lessons.title: A layer is a matrix
lessons.goal: Teach a dense layer in NumPy as a weight matrix and a bias vector. Build a layer of 4 neurons that takes 3 inputs and send a batch of 5 samples through it with the @ operator.
lessons.passes: The weights have shape (3, 4) and the layer's output has shape (5, 4).

lessons.title: The forward pass
lessons.goal: Teach the forward pass of a two-layer network in NumPy. Write forward(X) for a 2-4-1 network that chains a hidden layer with tanh and an output layer with sigmoid.
lessons.passes: forward returns shape (4, 1) for four samples, with every value between 0 and 1.

lessons.title: Measure the error with a loss
lessons.goal: Teach mean squared error and binary cross-entropy in NumPy by writing both as functions and scoring the untrained network's guesses against the right answers.
lessons.passes: mse gives 0.25 for predictions 0.5, 0.5 against targets 1, 0.

lessons.title: Gradients by hand
lessons.goal: Teach the chain rule for one sigmoid neuron with squared error. Work out the gradient for the weights and the bias on paper, code it in NumPy and check it against a numerical gradient.
lessons.passes: The hand-coded gradient matches the numerical gradient to within 1e-6.

lessons.title: Gradient descent
lessons.goal: Teach gradient descent in NumPy by training the single neuron to act as an AND gate, nudging the weights and bias against the gradient with a learning rate for 2000 steps.
lessons.passes: The loss ends lower than it began and all four AND cases round to the right answer.

lessons.title: Backpropagation through two layers
lessons.goal: Teach backpropagation in NumPy for the 2-4-1 network. Write backward so it returns a gradient for each weight matrix and bias, and check one of them against a numerical gradient.
lessons.passes: Each gradient has the shape of its parameter and one passes a numerical check.

lessons.title: Train a tiny network on XOR
lessons.goal: Teach a full training loop in NumPy. Train the 2-4-1 network on the four XOR points with forward, loss, backward and update, starting from seeded random weights, and print the loss as it falls.
lessons.passes: After training, the network's outputs round to 0, 1, 1, 0 for the XOR inputs.

project.title: A network that finds a circle
project.brief: Train a network on your own, with only NumPy, to tell whether a 2D point lies inside a circle. Make 200 random points, train a 2-8-1 network and print its accuracy.
checks: The notebook imports numpy and no machine learning library
The loss printed at the end is lower than the loss at the start
Accuracy on the 200 points is at least 90 percent

lessons.title: Move around the 3D viewport
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner the Blender viewport. Orbit, pan, zoom, the front, side and top views, and frame the selected object.
lessons.passes: The cube is framed in the front view.

lessons.title: Move, rotate and scale
lessons.goal: Teach G, R and S in Blender with axis keys and typed numbers by placing a cube, a cone and a sphere at set spots.
lessons.passes: The cube is at X 2, the cone is turned 90 degrees and the sphere is half size.

lessons.title: Edit mode: vertices, edges, faces
lessons.goal: Teach Blender Edit mode and the three select modes by pulling one edge of a cube up to make a wedge.
lessons.passes: One edge of the cube sits 1 m higher than the others.

lessons.title: Extrude and inset: the cup
lessons.goal: Teach Blender inset and extrude by hollowing a cylinder into the cup of a mug.
lessons.passes: The cylinder has a hollow with a wall and a floor.

lessons.title: Loop cuts and bevels
lessons.goal: Teach Blender loop cuts and bevel by adding two loops for the handle and beveling the rim of the mug.
lessons.passes: The mug has two new edge loops and a beveled rim.

lessons.title: Build the handle
lessons.goal: Teach extruding faces and bridging edge loops in Blender by growing a handle out of the side of the mug.
lessons.passes: The handle joins the mug in two places and the mesh is one piece.

lessons.title: Subdivision and smooth shading
lessons.goal: Teach Blender modifiers by adding Subdivision Surface at level 2 to the mug and turning on smooth shading.
lessons.passes: The mug has a Subdivision modifier at level 2 and smooth shading.

lessons.title: Give it a material
lessons.goal: Teach Blender materials with the Principled BSDF by giving the mug a glossy ceramic color.
lessons.passes: The mug has a material with roughness under 0.3.

lessons.title: Light it and aim the camera
lessons.goal: Teach Blender lights and the camera by adding an area light and framing the whole mug in the camera view.
lessons.passes: The scene has an area light and the camera sees the whole mug.

lessons.title: Render and save an image
lessons.goal: Teach rendering in Blender. Pick a render engine, set the size, render and save a PNG.
lessons.passes: A PNG render is saved next to the .blend file.

project.title: A desk lamp, modeled and rendered
project.brief: Model a simple desk lamp on your own from a cylinder and a cone. Give it two materials, light it and save a render.
checks: At least two mesh objects, one with a Subdivision or Bevel modifier
Two different materials are assigned
A render is saved as an image

lessons.title: Run your first Python file
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to create hello.py in VS Code, print two lines and run it from the terminal with python3.
lessons.passes: hello.py runs and prints both lines.

lessons.title: Variables and numbers
lessons.goal: Teach Python variables and arithmetic by building a tip calculator in tip.py with a bill, a tip percent and a total.
lessons.passes: tip.py prints the right total for a 40 dollar bill at 20 percent.

lessons.title: Strings and f-strings
lessons.goal: Teach Python strings, indexing, upper and lower, and f-strings by printing a name badge from two variables.
lessons.passes: The badge prints the name in capitals inside an f-string.

lessons.title: If, elif and else
lessons.goal: Teach Python comparisons and if, elif, else by writing a ticket price picker for child, adult and senior ages.
lessons.passes: Ages 8, 30 and 70 each print the right price.

lessons.title: For and while loops
lessons.goal: Teach Python for loops with range and while loops by printing a times table and a countdown that stops at zero.
lessons.passes: The times table has ten rows and the countdown ends at zero.

lessons.title: Lists
lessons.goal: Teach Python lists by building a shopping list. Append, remove, sort, slice and loop over it.
lessons.passes: The list prints sorted with the removed item gone.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.goal: Teach Python functions with parameters and return values by turning the tip calculator into a function and calling it three times.
lessons.passes: A function with two parameters returns the total and is called three times.

lessons.title: Dictionaries
lessons.goal: Teach Python dictionaries by counting how often each word appears in a sentence and printing the top three.
lessons.passes: The word counts match the sentence.

lessons.title: Read and write a file
lessons.goal: Teach reading and writing text files in Python with open and with, by saving a list of scores to scores.txt and reading it back.
lessons.passes: scores.txt exists and the script prints what it holds.

lessons.title: Read an error message
lessons.goal: Teach a beginner to read Python tracebacks by fixing three small broken scripts, a NameError, a TypeError and an IndexError.
lessons.passes: All three scripts run with no error.

project.title: A number guessing game
project.brief: Write guess.py on your own. Pick a random number, loop until the guess is right, say higher or lower, and save the best score to a file.
checks: guess.py runs with no error
The right number ends the game with the number of tries
The best score is written to scores.txt

proposal.title: 3D print a phone stand

lessons.title: Find your way around FreeCAD
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner FreeCAD. Make a new document, switch to the Part Design workbench, create a body and move the view.

lessons.title: Your first sketch
lessons.goal: Teach FreeCAD sketching by drawing a closed rectangle on the XY plane of a Part Design body.

lessons.title: Constrain it fully
lessons.goal: Teach FreeCAD sketch constraints. Add length, width and position until the rectangle is fully constrained at 60 by 40 mm.

lessons.title: Pad it into a plate
lessons.goal: Teach the Pad tool in FreeCAD Part Design by turning the 60 by 40 mm sketch into a plate 5 mm thick.

lessons.title: Sketch on a face and cut holes
lessons.goal: Teach sketching on a face and the Pocket tool in FreeCAD by cutting two 4 mm screw holes through the plate.

lessons.title: Fillets and chamfers
lessons.goal: Teach the Fillet and Chamfer tools in FreeCAD by rounding the outer edges of the hook by 2 mm.

lessons.title: Clearance with a peg and three holes
lessons.goal: Teach clearance for 3D printing in FreeCAD Part Design by modelling a 10 mm peg and a test plate with holes of 10.0, 10.2 and 10.4 mm to find the fit your printer gives.

lessons.title: Wall thickness
lessons.goal: Teach wall thickness for 3D printing in FreeCAD by hollowing a 40 mm cube into an open tray with the Part Design Thickness tool, with 1.6 mm walls to suit a 0.4 mm nozzle.

project.title: A phone stand you could print
project.brief: Design a stand that holds a phone 75 mm wide at a reading angle and save it as an STL.
checks: One solid body and every sketch fully constrained
The slot fits a phone 75 mm wide with a lip of at least 8 mm
A watertight STL is saved
